places.name: Terasa Sirena (Rică Răducanu)
places.evidence: Press (romaniatv.net, prosport.ro, money.ro): family business of cousin Costică who cooks there; Rică Răducanu present each summer welcoming guests and taking orders

places.name: Terasa La Foișor
places.evidence: AmFostAcolo review states the owner is always present on site and complaints/wishes can be addressed to him directly; Tatar family cuisine

places.name: Cafe Efendi by Antik (Antik Cafe Efendi)
places.evidence: AmFostAcolo review: 'specialitati tataresti traditionale, patronul fiind tatar' — founded 1995 as a personal project to bring Tatar cuisine to the coast; owner presence itself not explicitly documented

places.name: Casa Maria
places.evidence: AmFostAcolo review recounts direct interaction with 'patronul' at the table, confirming the owner personally runs the floor

places.name: Restaurant Mediterraneo
places.area: quiet northern side of Neptun (Mediterraneo complex)
places.evidence: Tripadvisor reviews repeatedly note 'owners involved day by day' with returning guests greeted personally
